title: Hearty Crunchy Greek Cheese Keftedes
description: A crowd-pleasing Greek dish featuring cheese and crunchy double-rise bread, these garlicky keftedes are egg-free friendly and perfect for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the toasted bread, grated cheese, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well until the bread is evenly coated with the cheese and garlic mixture.
Add the olive oil, chopped parsley, and lemon zest to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Use your hands to shape the dough into small keftedes, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the keftedes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the keftedes in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the keftedes from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes.
Serve the keftedes warm and enjoy.
